feeds.title: Peter McCabe Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Peter McCabe. I am an Irish landscape photographer who for over 20 years has spent many a day, getting off the beaten track, exploring lesser worn paths to photograph the dramatic and subtle beauty of the Irish Landscape. My goal is to take you into the heart of the beautiful Irish landscape, enhance your photographic skills, and capture images that enhance your portfolio.

feeds.title: DKPHOTO Blog
feeds.description: My name is Daniel- wedding photography is my passion, and I aim to be the best wedding photographer you can get. It's a pleasure and a privilege for me to record so many wonderful weddings and to share the story of them with you in my blog.

feeds.title: Johanna King Photography Blog
feeds.description: HI! I'm Johanna King, a Dublin, Ireland, based documentary newborn & family photographer. I also travel nationwide. Using a documentary approach to photography, I provide you with a safe space where you can relax, be yourself, and forget about the camera.

feeds.title: Lensmen Blog
feeds.description: Lensmen Blog brings you updates on our latest work in photography, video production, time-lapse videos, and drone projects. Lensmen is one of the leading and oldest media companies in Ireland, covering years of major political and social events since 1952.

feeds.title: Deirdre Rusk Blog
feeds.description: I am Deirdre Rusk - a mother of three beautiful children. I think I truly found my love for photography when I became a mother. I strive to take photographs that show real human connections and capture personalities honestly, to give a genuine sense of a family or person, as beautiful as they are.

feeds.title: Wedding By Molten Sky
feeds.description: Molten Sky Weddings is a boutique photography business based in Galway city in the west of Ireland.Our fresh approach to weddings is perfect for couples who want great wedding photography and wedding videography with minimum fuss.

feeds.title: Hendrickson Fine Art Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Nancy Wojack Hendrickson. My mission, my goal is to print and share these Irish photos, our love of Ireland and the legacy my late husband, Barry Thomas Hendrickson, left behind.

feeds.title: Kieran Russell Photography Blog
feeds.description: My name is Kieran Russell and I live and work in Waterford, Ireland. One of the main reasons I set up this website is to have a central location for all my images that I have complete control of. The Blog I intend to use a knowledge bank for some of the locations I visit with a view to sharing some of my experiences and hopefully helpful tips about locations, access, the best time to shot, etc.

feeds.title: Stewart Kenny Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Stewart Kenny. Photography training, teaching and lecturing have been at the forefront of my photography career for many years. My passion for learning and teaching is constant, driving me to acquire several qualifications in training, coaching and course design as well as teaching for many colleges and schools around Ireland. I am currently the head of training for Dublin Photography School.

feeds.title: Stefan Schnebelt Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Stefan Schnebelt. Over the past 25 years, I travelled all over Ireland again and again and worked on my photography style. For some years now, I have been sharing my fascination for photography with the participants of my photo tours. During this photo training, a lot of photographic know-how is transferred and intensively exercised.

feeds.title: Landscape Photography Ireland Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kieran. Welcome to my Blog where I share some photography tips and tricks as well as some amazing new products and Photography related news. I am a photographer living in beautiful Clonakilty in West Cork, Ireland.

feeds.title: Stephen O'Sullivan Blog
feeds.description: I'm Stephen O'Sullivan and this is my blog for thoughts and ideas on Relaxed Wedding Photography as well as some random stuff. I love weddings and I love being a wedding photographer. I passionately believe that Wedding Photography should be relaxed, fun and organic & the photographs should be real, telling YOUR story, the way you remember it.

feeds.title: Deirdre Langan Blog
feeds.description: HI! I'm Deirdre Langan. I'm from Leitrim but living & loving Galway since the mid-1990s. I've been a professional photographer for more than 10 years, since making the career change from software engineering.

feeds.title: Camila Lee Photography Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Camila Lee. My job is to make sure your kids have photos with you in them to look back on. My story with photography began in 2007 when I was in fashion college. I fell in love with photography, and have been married to a camera ever since. My photo sessions are very relaxed and I focus on capturing real interactions between the family members.

feeds.title: IG Studio Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Greg. I am a dad to Victoria and Max and husband to my awesome wife Iwona. I'm passionate about photography and specialize in documentary wedding photography. I photograph each wedding in an authentic and artistic way.

feeds.title: Photo Museum Ireland
feeds.description: Gallery of Photography Ireland is the leading voice for photography in Ireland. We are dedicated to fostering a dynamic culture of photographic practice across a broad range of platforms. Our mission is to develop a dynamic photographic culture by supporting artists to present excellent art that actively engages wide & diverse audiences.

feeds.title: Amber Baruch Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Amber Baruch. Having over 5 years of experience photographing weddings, I know the best ways to document your relationship, is to let things happen. My goal is to blend in to let everything unfold as it should. Have a browse, learn plenty of tips and tricks and get some inspiration from one of the many blog posts.

feeds.title: Weddings By Kara Blog
feeds.description: As wedding industry professional photographers we blog about all things wedding related. Beautiful real wedding photography, articles and advice for your fabulous day. Weddings by KARA is Karina and Rachel, a photography duo based in Greystones, Ireland. We work nationwide and internationally. Our focus is on recording the timeless elegance of your day in a relaxed and natural style.
